description: Guided opt-out fer SearchPeopleFree. A sailor follows the steps on the checklist; OpenOptOut hands over a one-time email address an' clicks any confirmation link.
instructions: Search searchpeoplefree.com by name, phone number, address an' email; folk be often listed more than once. Fer each record, use searchpeoplefree.com/opt-out, giving {contact_email} as the email address. Then smash "I've done this".
